links.outcome: LLM output accuracy and safety scored against reference-standard algorithm by blinded expert panel
links.effect: Claude Sonnet 4.6 scored higher on AIES-CPV (24.50 ± 1.43), key-action (7.93 ± 0.25), and GQS (4.90 ± 0.31) than ChatGPT 5.5 and Gemini 3 Flash (Friedman p < 0.001).
links.quote: Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieved significantly higher total AIES-CPV (24.50 ± 1.43), key-action (7.93 ± 0.25), and GQS (4.90 ± 0.31) scores than ChatGPT 5.5 and Gemini 3 Flash (Friedman p < 0.001 for all); ChatGPT 5.5 and Gemini 3 Flash did not differ significantly.

screen.reason: Evaluates performance and safety errors of three LLMs on hypothetical clinical poisoning vignettes scored by an expert clinician panel, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
